about: Germany: the Herrentunnel's toll (B 104/B 75, Lübeck), set under the Fernstraßenbauprivatfinanzierungsgesetz and published by the operator only as an image (Gebührentabelle, gültig ab 01.03.2025) linked from its Gebührentabelle page. Transcribed by hand; tools/tables fetches the image again and says if it has changed (sha256). Classes by height over the front axle (over 130 cm) and axles: B 2, C 3, D 4 and more. Barpreis is the price at the plaza; Quick-Box/RFID the price with the operator's tag (no basic fee). The Plus tariff (with a monthly fee per fleet) isn't used.
